counter_arguments: The PR is a dependency bump of the Stripe SDK, which has no impact on the downstream ledger's database schema or column types.
The workaround's revisit condition explicitly requires the downstream ledger to be migrated to bigint columns (ticket PAY-240), which is a database schema change, not a library upgrade.
The PR message explicitly states the changes are only 'improved error logging and deprecation notices', which are unrelated to integer overflow handling in the ledger.
The PR does not touch the anchor code (the capping logic) or any ledger-related code at all.
The PR does not close or reference ticket PAY-240, which is the specific ticket that must be completed to remove this workaround.
reasoning: This is a clear non-match. The workaround exists because the downstream ledger uses integer columns that overflow above 50000 cents. The only way to resolve this is to migrate those columns to bigint (as specified in ticket PAY-240). The PR under review is a Stripe SDK version bump that only improves error logging and deprecation notices. It has zero impact on the ledger's database schema, does not modify the capping logic, and does not address the root cause (integer column overflow). A dependency bump that only changes logging is not a resolution of a database schema limitation.
